Palm Springs, California · eat

Restaurants in Palm Springs for cyclists

Where to eat in Palm Springs the night before a ride and the afternoon after. Nothing fancy. Real food, real portions, places that are open when you need them.

Restaurants in Palm Springs for cyclists, listed

  1. Sherman's Deli & Bakery

    Deli · 401 E Tahquitz Canyon Way, Palm Springs, CA 92262

    After the ride, Zone 1: a New York deli on Tahquitz Canyon Way, two blocks east of the Tour start, pastrami and a bakery counter, big portions. Open 8 a.m. to 9 p.m. every day (its own page), so breakfast is there when you get back. There's a second Sherman's at 73161 Country Club Dr in Palm Desert, same hours. Outdoor seating and bike parking weren't on the page.

  2. King's Highway

    Diner · 701 E Palm Canyon Dr, Palm Springs, CA 92264

    The early breakfast, Zone 1: the diner at the Ace Hotel on the south end of town, from 7 a.m. daily. Dinner 4 to 9 Monday to Thursday and 4 to 10 Friday to Sunday (its own page). Indoor and patio tables. Koffi South is next door. The early breakfast in Palm Springs that isn't a bagel.

  3. Townie Bagels

    Bagels and breakfast · 650 E Sunny Dunes Rd, Palm Springs, CA 92264

    Breakfast after the ride, Zone 1, in Sunny Dunes east of downtown: water-boiled bagels and breakfast sandwiches, 6:30 a.m. to noon, closed Tuesday (its own page). Gone by lunch. Also under Coffee.

  4. Las Casuelas Terraza

    Mexican · 222 S Palm Canyon Dr, Palm Springs, CA 92262

    The night before the Tour de Palm Springs, Zone 1, on the street it starts on: enchiladas, mole and tamales on three patios, one with a bar and a bandstand, one on the sidewalk. Open 11 a.m. to 10 p.m. Thursday to Monday (its own page), closed Tuesday and Wednesday, so a Friday night works. Reservations online or at (760) 325-2794; large parties by email through the site. A Tour sponsor.

  5. Lulu California Bistro

    American · 200 S Palm Canyon Dr, Palm Springs, CA 92262

    The big room for a group the night before, Zone 1: a long menu, an outdoor terrace on Palm Canyon a block from the Tour start, and a mezzanine the site says is for parties. Open 11 to 9 Monday to Thursday, 11 to 10 Friday, 9 a.m. to 10 Saturday, 9 to 9 Sunday (its own page), so it's a Sunday brunch after a ride too. Reservations on OpenTable; (760) 327-5858. A Tour sponsor.

  6. Taqueria Tlaquepaque

    Mexican · 362 S Palm Canyon Dr, Palm Springs, CA 92262

    The cheap plate, Zone 1: a carne asada burrito on South Palm Canyon, the Tour's street, with a patio. Its Tripadvisor listing (reviews to Sept 2026) has it open daily to 9, to 10 Friday and Saturday; confirm by phone. A second store sits at 650 E Sunny Dunes Rd, Ste 5, in the same plaza as Townie Bagels, open 8 to 9 daily per its listing. (760) 325-1125.

  7. Amigo Room at the Ace Hotel

    Bar food · 701 E Palm Canyon Dr, Palm Springs, CA 92264

    Late, when the day ran long, Zone 1: the Ace's bar is open 4 p.m. to 11 Sunday to Thursday and 4 to 1 a.m. Friday and Saturday, and the kitchen closes an hour before the bar (the hotel's page), so food to 10 most nights and to midnight on the weekend. What the kitchen serves wasn't on the page. A bar, so expect 21 and over.
